question: What is the spiritual significance of the constant washing of the mouth?
premises: The washing of the mouth is performed constantly.
It is described as having gone upward.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is directed upward toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The ritual or symbolic meaning of ūrddha-gatam is interpretive.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth rises upward to Brahman.
